description: Calculate federal income tax for an individual taxpayer. Supports TY2024 through TY2026. Includes bracket breakdown, effective/marginal rates, SE tax, NIIT, Additional Medicare Tax, QBI deduction, capital gains, and child tax credit. All calculations run locally — no data is sent to any server.

aboveTheLineDeductions.description: Above-the-line deductions (HSA, student loan interest, etc.)

aotcRefundableAllowed.description: Whether refundable AOTC is allowed after under-age-24 support rules

aotcStudentQualifiedExpenses.description: Qualified AOTC expenses per already-verified eligible student

capitalGains.description: Long-term capital gains (can be negative for losses)

capitalGainsLongTerm.description: Whether capital gains are long-term (default: true)

dependents.description: Legacy count of qualifying child dependents for nonrefundable CTC only

earlyRetirementDistributionSubjectToPena.description: Taxable early-distribution amount remaining after exceptions

earnedIncome.description: Schedule 8812 earned income used for ACTC

earnedIncomeCredit.description: EITC used by the 3-or-more-child ACTC payroll-tax method

grossIncome.description: Total gross income including supplied capital gains, qualified dividends, Social Security benefits, and gross retirement distributions

hasForm2555.description: Whether Form 2555 is filed, which makes ACTC unavailable

isoExerciseSpread.description: ISO stock option exercise spread (for AMT calculation)

itemizedDeductions.description: Total itemized deductions (if greater than standard deduction)

lifetimeLearningQualifiedExpenses.description: Qualified LLC expenses not used for AOTC or another benefit

longTermCapitalLossCarryover.description: Prior-year long-term capital loss carryover as a positive amount

netInvestmentIncome.description: Total net investment income for NIIT, including taxable interest, dividends, gains, rents, royalties, and passive income

otherDependentsForOdc.description: Dependents already verified for the nonrefundable Credit for Other Dependents

qualifiedBusinessIncome.description: Qualified Business Income for Section 199A deduction

qualifiedBusinessIsSstb.description: Whether the business is a specified service trade or business

qualifiedBusinessPropertyBasis.description: Unadjusted basis immediately after acquisition of qualified property; pass 0 when none

qualifiedBusinessW2Wages.description: Section 199A W-2 wages; pass 0 when none

qualifiedDividends.description: Qualified dividends included in gross income, taxed at preferential rates but not netted with capital losses

qualifyingChildrenForCtc.description: Children already verified as CTC/ACTC qualifying children under age 17 with required SSNs

retirementDistributions.description: Gross Form 1099-R distributions included in grossIncome

shortTermCapitalLossCarryover.description: Prior-year short-term capital loss carryover as a positive amount

socialSecurityBenefits.description: Net Social Security benefits included in grossIncome

socialSecurityTaxesPaid.description: Schedule 8812 payroll-tax amount for the 3-or-more-child ACTC method

stateTaxDeducted.description: State/local taxes included in itemized deductions (for AMT)

taxExemptInterest.description: Tax-exempt interest used by the Publication 915 worksheet

name: calculate_federal_tax
